material.description: apt installs (npm, neofetch, etc.) fail with 'GDBus.Error:org.freedesktop.DBus.Error.Spawn.PermissionsInvalid: The permission of the setuid helper is not correct'. Root-cause and fix so apt works repeatedly.
material.subject: Fix GDBus Spawn.PermissionsInvalid on apt installs
material.witness: Reproduced verbatim in dbus-main2/out/org.freedesktop.PackageKit.log: 'Error: GDBus.Error:org.freedesktop.DBus.Error.Spawn.PermissionsInvalid: The permission of the setuid helper is not correct' with dbus-daemon --system (uid 100 messagebus). Root cause: execve ignores S_ISUID so the setuid-root /usr/lib/dbus-1.0/dbus-daemon-launch-helper (mode 4754 root:messagebus) cannot escalate; chmod 4755/4750 both still rc=1. Fix: root-user system bus config /etc/dbus-1/qqbox-system.conf (<user>root</user>). Witnessed: bus_rc=0, PackageKit ping_rc=0, NO_DBUS_ERROR across apt logs, apt-get install fastfetch rc=0 and tree rc=0 repeatedly (x26-correct/run.log).

material.subject: Restore the bottom dock and taskbar navigation on Xubuntu 26 desktop
material.witness: Live VNC 5905 (live-5905-dock/): QQBOX_BOOT_READY, bwrap_shim_installed=yes, xfce4_panel_procs=2, xwininfo 'xfce4-panel' 1280x41+0+0 +0+759, qqbox-desktop.png 1280x800 10,087 distinct colors with 2,623 in the bottom 50px band, and a screenshot showing the Applications menu, three launchers and a tasklist with 'Example Domain - Chromium' and 'QQBOX-TERMINAL'. Independent RFB 3.8 wire capture over TCP 5905: qbox:99, 1280x800, 1 raw rect 4,096,000 bytes, 10,086 colors, bottom band 2,623, 80/80 sampled pixels byte-identical to the local screenshot. Root cause: 26.04 gdk-pixbuf routes scalable icons through glycin loaders spawned by bwrap; bwrap fails verbatim 'Failed to make / slave: Bad address' under qqbox, so xfce4-panel aborted on a GTK icon-helper assertion. Fix: narrow bwrap shim execs the real glycin loader and delegates all other calls to bwrap.qqbox-orig; baked in Dockerfile and carried idempotently in the startup script. Refuted alternatives witnessed: librsvg2-common alone, removing glycin conf.d, GDK_PIXBUF_MODULE_FILE override, and an off-by-one shift (status 127). All other requirements still green: Ubuntu 26.04.1, vim_rc=0, vi_rc=0, paplay_rc=0, ping_rc=0, apt update/install rc=0, NO_DBUS_ERROR, xwallpaper_rc=0, Node 18.19.1/npm 9.2.0/Claude 1.0.128. Commits e0086e6 and b8ef5ed pushed; gates fmt/build/test/clippy/witness/zh-Hant all rc=0.

material.subject: Fix random XFCE errors and child PTY errors on the live 5905 desktop
material.witness: Live VNC 5905 after cutover (live-5905-clean/): QQBOX_BOOT_READY. No ERROR/CRITICAL/assertion/child-exec/PTY/Traceback/Segmentation lines in xfce.log, panel.log, terminal.log, wm.log or xfdesktop.log. Single xfce4-panel process, window 1280x41+0+0 +0+759. Terminal child bash has a real PTY; typed RFB input 'echo LIVE_5905_CLEAN_OK' echoed back at root@qbox:/out# with zero warnings; independent RFB 3.8 frame qbox:99 1280x800 4,096,000 raw bytes 9,346 colors. Root causes fixed: literal backslash-x27 in /root/.bashrc from printf -> octal backslash-047 (x27: command not found); SHELLOPTS= on the terminal child (job-control Bad file descriptor); evidence script bash -i -c without PTY replaced by grep; duplicate xfwm4/xfce4-panel/xfdesktop removed (session owns one); LaunchGNOME=false + gnome-keyring + xdg-user-dirs installed; desktop-icons/style=0; chromium.desktop stub override; terminal via session autostart. Remaining lines are informational: one systemd-proxy WARNING, _NET_* assuming messages, expected PackageKit ServiceUnknown. Commit a708b5b pushed; gates fmt/build/test/clippy/witness/zh-Hant all rc=0.

material.subject: Determine why the dock vanished at runtime
material.witness: Forensic root cause: RFB 3.8 capture on 5905 before fix = bare wallpaper, 1280x800, 17,916 colors, ServerInit 'qbox:99' unchanged; x11vnc.log has one 'screen setup finished' at 06:18:58 and no X restart. xfce.log: Thunar aborted, repeated 'Wnck:ERROR:../libwnck/xutils.c:1510:default_icon_at_size: assertion failed (base)' + 'Bail out!', then xfce4-terminal/xfsettingsd/xfwm4/xfce4-panel all 'ICE I/O Error' and 'Disconnected from session manager' at 21:10:23. xfce4-session owned the session bus -> its death killed every client and unmapped every window; wallpaper root pixmap survived. No restart mechanism. Falsification: Xvfb restart ruled out (same ServerInit, no second screen setup). VNC reconnect ruled out (client_count normal). glycin ruled out as primary (ICE error hit all clients).

material.subject: Restore dock and navbar on live 5905 after runtime disappearance
material.witness: Live 5905 restored by cutover to event-driven supervision (commit a961894 pushed). Removed xfce4-session; own persistent session bus + xfconfd; supervise xfwm4/xfce4-panel/xfdesktop/terminal/Chromium via event-driven 'wait $pid' loops (no sleep/timeout/periodic recheck) with a circuit breaker. Deliberate adversarial kill: pkill -x xfce4-panel rc=0 -> supervisor.log 'panel exited rc=0 -> restarting' with the panel window back at 1280x41+0+0 +0+759, one panel process, zero duplicates. Independent RFB 3.8 frame on live 5905: qbox:99, 1280x800, 4,096,000 raw bytes, 7,484 colors, 1,182 bottom-band colors. Screenshot shows Applications menu, 3 launchers, tasklist with 'Example Domain - Chromium' and 'QQBOX-TERMINAL', Chromium rendering https://example.com/. Fresh boot logs: no ICE error, no Wnck assertion, no duplicate-manager message. Chromium --password-store=basic removed the gnome-keyring modal. Gates fmt/build/test/clippy/witness/shell -n/zh-Hant all rc=0.
